title: Human Neural Organoids for Studying Brain Cancer and Neurodegenerative Diseases
protocol: Thaw 300 μL of extracellular matrix at 4°C.
Gently mix the thawed extracellular matrix with 15 mL of cold DMEM medium to avoid premature gelation.
Add 7.5 mL of the extracellular matrix solution to both T150 flasks.
Incubate the dishes coated with extracellular matrix at 37°C for at least 1 hour (maximum overnight).
Remove the medium from the incubated dishes.
Seed hESCs onto the extracellular matrix-coated dishes at a density of 6.5 x 10^4 cells/cm².
Maintain H1 hESC cell line in hESC medium supplemented with 1% penicillin/streptomycin.
Add 7.5 mL of enzymatic solution to a T75 cm² flask over a period of 1-2 minutes at 37°C when passaging the cells.
Once cells are completely detached, add 7.5 mL of DMEM-F12 medium and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 300 x g.
Re-plate the cells onto extracellular matrix-coated dishes in the same medium containing ROCK inhibitor (10 μM) for 24 hours to allow better survival.
Replace the hESC medium with serum-free medium supplemented with 10 µM ROCK inhibitor.
Incubate hESC colonies until they reach 60% confluency.
Remove the medium from the hESC culture dish.
Rinse the cells once with PBS without Ca2+/Mg2+.
Add 5 mL of enzymatic dissolution solution to the cells and incubate at 37 °C for 1-2 min.
Collect cells in serum-free medium containing 10 µM ROCK inhibitor.
Centrifuge collected cells at 300 x g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant from the centrifuged cells.
Count cells in serum-free medium supplemented with 10 µM ROCK inhibitor.
Rinse microwell plate with 2 mL of serum-free medium per well.
Centrifuge the plate at 1200 x g for 5 min to remove bubbles.
Prepare a cell suspension containing 28.2 million cells in 12.5 mL of serum-free medium supplemented with ROCK inhibitor.
Dispense 1000 cells into each microwell.
Centrifuge the cells again at 300 x g for 5 min.
Place the plate in an incubator at 37 °C overnight (maximum 36 hours).
Collect the spheres using a P1000 and place them in a 6 well plate.
Add 2 mL of B27 medium to each well.
Mix DMEM-F12 GlutaMAX and Neurobasal medium at a ratio of 1:1.
Supplement the mixed medium with 1% B27 supplements and 1% non-essential amino acids (NEAA).
Prepare dual-SMAD inhibition cocktail by mixing 10 µM TGFβ/Activin/Nodal inhibitor and 0.5 µM bone morphogenic protein (BMP) inhibitor.
Culture the spheres in rotation at 60 rpm on an orbital shaker to prevent sticking together or to the plate.

Change the medium every 2-3 days by letting the spheres fall for 5 minutes, removing half of the medium (2 mL), and adding fresh B27 medium supplemented with growth factors and inhibitors without centrifuging the spheres.
From days 1-4, culture the spheres in B27 medium supplemented with dual-SMAD inhibition cocktail to promote neural induction.
From days 4-11, add 10 ng/mL epidermal growth factor (EGF) and 10 ng/mL basic fibroblast factor (bFGF) to the B27 medium for proliferation of hESC-derived neural rosettes.
Culture the spheres in B27 medium supplemented with 0.5 μM BMP inhibitor from days 11 to 13.
Culture the spheres in B27 medium supplemented with 10 ng/mL GDNF, 10 ng/mL BDNF, and 1 μM γ-secretase inhibitor from days 13 to 21.
Plate approximately 1,000 spheres on a hydrophilic PTFE membrane (6 mm diameter, 0.4 µm) deposited on a culture plate insert designed for a 6-well plate on day 21.
Stop rotation of the plates from this step onward.

Add 1 mL of B27 medium supplemented with growth factors and inhibitors to each well underneath the membrane insert every 2-3 days (usually on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday) for the following 3 weeks of differentiation.
Cultivate human neural organoids in the same neural maturation medium from days 21 to 25.
Cultivate human neural organoids with B27 medium supplemented only by 1 μM γ-secretase inhibitor from days 25 to 28.
From days 28-39, stop adding the γ-secretase inhibitor and continue human neural organoid culture in B27 medium only.
Isolate GICs by fragmenting a high grade human GBM biopsy.
Transfer the tumor piece into a beaker containing 0.25% trypsin in 0.1 mM EDTA (4:1) and slowly stir at 37 °C for 30-60 min depending on tumor size.
Plate the dissociated cells in 75 cm² tissue culture flasks plated at 2,500-5,000 cells per cm² in GIC medium.
Once the GICs are well-established and growing, remove N2 and G5 supplements from the GIC medium.
One day before adding the cells onto the organoid, dissociate the GICs and count them.
Rinse the microwell plate with 2 ml of GIC medium and centrifuge at maximum speed to remove bubbles (1000 x g).
Place the GICs at 1,000 cells per well to obtain one gliomasphere per microwell.
Incubate overnight at 37 °C.
Add one gliomasphere on top of the neural tissue using a large bore pipet tip.
Place the 6 well plate back in the incubator.
Amplify hESCs in 2D culture up to 60% confluency (day 0).
Replace stem cell media with serum-free medium for neural induction.
Supplement the culture medium with 0.5 µM BMP inhibitor and 10 µM TGFβ/Activin/Nodal inhibitor.
Add 10 µM ROCK inhibitor for 24 h to increase survival rate of cells during passage.
Prepare the microwell plate with 2.5 mL per well of serum-free medium supplemented with 0.5 µM BMP inhibitor, 10 µM TGFβ/Activin/Nodal inhibitor, and 10 µM ROCK inhibitor.
Add 100 ng/mL Sonic Hedgehog (SHH) and 100 ng/mL fibroblast growth factor 8 (FGF8).
Add 2 µM smoothened agonist to specify cells towards the ventral pattern of the neural tube.
Centrifuge the plate at 1200 x g for 5 min to remove air bubbles from the microwells.
Remove the medium after 1 day of neural induction in 2D.
Wash with PBS without Ca2+/MgCl2+ quickly.
Dissociate colonies into single cell suspension by adding 7.5 mL of recombinant enzymatic solution in a T75 cm2 flask.
Incubate for 2 min at 37 °C then complete with 7.5 mL of DMEM-F12.
Collect the cell suspension and centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant and count the cells in the same medium used to prepare the microwell plate.
Adjust the medium volume to obtain a cell suspension allowing to form neurospheres containing 1000 cells per microwell.
Prepare 4.7 million cells in 2.5 mL of medium and add it to the previous 2.5 mL of medium already placed in the plate.
Gently shake the plate.
Centrifuge the microwell plate at 300 x g for 5 min.
Incubate the plate at 37 °C for 24 h to generate spheres.
Gently flush the microwells with the medium and collect then transfer the spheres in tissue-treated six-well plate.
Replace medium with Neurobasal medium supplemented with 1% B27, 1x NEAA, 2 mM L-glutamine, and 1% of penicillin/streptomycin.
Add regionalization factors SHH, FGF8, smoothened agonist, and dual-SMAD inhibition small molecules.
Place spheres in rotation at 37 °C (60 rpm, orbital shaker).
Change half-medium freshly supplemented every 2-3 days.
Supplement the medium with 3 µM GSK-3β inhibitor starting on Day 3.
Maintain GSK-3β inhibitor in the medium up to day 13.
Split into two new tissue-treated 6 well plates on Day 3.
Replace regionalization factors SHH, FGF8, smoothened agonist, and dual-SMAD inhibition cocktail with 0.5 mM dibutyryl cAMP on Day 8.
Add 20 nM inhibitor of histone deacetylase to the medium starting on Day 8.
Include 1 µM γ-secretase inhibitor in the medium starting on Day 8.
Add 10 ng/mL GDNF to the medium starting on Day 8.
Add 10 ng/mL BDNF to the medium starting on Day 8.
Include 1 ng/mL transforming growth factor β3 (TGFβ3) in the medium starting on Day 8.
Add 5 ng/mL FGF20 to the medium starting on Day 8.
Generate neural organoids by seeding around 100 neurospheres under air-liquid interface conditions on PTFE membrane on Day 21.
Transfer the membrane to a culture plate insert with a 0.4 mm pore size.
Add 1.2 mL of neural maturation medium used for neurosphere differentiation.
Stop any rotation from this step onwards.
Change the medium every 2-3 days until the required differentiation time point is achieved.
Lysate 40 neurospheres with 350 µL of RLT buffer supplemented with 3.5 µL of 2-mercaptoethanol on the indicated day of differentiation.
Extract RNA from the lysed neurospheres using an RNA extraction kit according to manufacturer's instructions.
Quantify total RNA concentrations.
Perform reverse transcription of 300 ng of total RNA using a reverse transcription kit for quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) following manufacturer’s instructions.
Perform qPCR analysis on real-time PCR detection systems based on asymmetrical cyanine dye detection.
Normalize the data with housekeeping genes: glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (GAPDH) and elongation factor 1-alpha (EF1).
Lys neural organoids in 100 mL of 0.1 N perchloric acid (HClO4) for 15 min at 4 °C, vortexing vigorously every 5 minutes.
Centrifuge the lysed samples and collect the supernatant.
Store the supernatant at -20°C for dopamine dosage.
Separate analytes using a C-18 column in isocratic mode at a flow rate of 1 mL/minute.
Detect dopamine with electrochemical detection using a coulometric detector set at +200 mV potential.
Transfer neurospheres to the center of a porous MEA device using a dissection microscope.
Record electrophysiological signals using an amplifier and data acquisition system.
Measure signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) as the standard deviation of voltage over 5 minutes.
